name: Garanti BBVA
verdict: Majority owned by BBVA (85.97%), a listed Spanish bank with no controlling shareholder. Nothing found.
note: Main sponsor of the Turkish Basketball Federation's national teams since 2001; the national teams' jersey and main-sponsorship agreement was extended five years on 27 January 2026 (Garanti BBVA press release; Karar, 2026-01-27), and its logo is on the front of the national team shirt. Owner chain: BBVA holds 85.97% (garanti-bbva-bbva-ownership); BBVA is a listed Spanish bank with no shareholder with significant influence (bbva-ownership-record). No state in the chain and no human-rights finding against the company that passes METHOD.md, so rated none.
